buyer_question: How do inserts and finishes affect rigid gift box sourcing?
buyer_context: premium gifts, cosmetics, wellness sets, electronics and retail presentation boxes
short_answer: Buyers should compare suppliers by the clarity of their product route, RFQ inputs, material and finish discussion, and how well the packaging structure fits the product use case. For rigid gift boxes, start with box structure and closure style, insert or tray requirement, surface finish reference, product weight, presentation and shipping route.
